adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the permission check sets `isTeamAdminOrOwner` to `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner to pass that branch. A team admin who is not also an owner will fail `isTeamAdminOrOwner`, and if they are neither the booking organizer (`booking.userId === user.id`) nor an attendee (`booking.attendees` contains their email), the handler throws `FORBIDDEN` (`you_do_not_have_permission`). Meanwhile, `BookingListItem.tsx` adds the "additional_guests" action unconditionally (no permission gating in the diff), so the UI can present an entry point that predictably errors for team admins.
